name: Cape Naturaliste Road
_note: Cape Naturaliste Road (Tourist Drive 250) from the north edge of Dunsborough to the Cape Naturaliste lighthouse: past the Eagle Bay turn-off, then up onto the cape through coastal heath and peppermint, ending at the lighthouse car park loop (the one-way loop itself left out). Point to point, about 11 km. 5 m LiDAR covers only the first 3 km out of Dunsborough; the cape is on the 30 m fallback.
